Terms and Conditions

Offers valid from June 18, 2026 to July 15, 2026 for new and returning HBO Max customers directly via hbomax.com.

Eligible customers can save 40% when subscribing to one of the following prepaid plans:

  1. the HBO Max Basic With Ads yearly plan at a discounted rate of $78.99 for the first year; OR
  2. the HBO Max Standard yearly plan at a discounted rate of $132.99 for the first year; OR
  3. the HBO Max Premium yearly plan at a discounted rate of $164.99 for the first year (each, an "Offer" and collectively, the "Offers").

The applicable subscription fee for the discount period will be billed in full at the time you enroll in the Offer. After the discount period, your subscription will automatically renew each year at the then-current subscription price (now $109.99/yr. plus applicable taxes for the Basic With Ads yearly plan, $184.99/yr. plus applicable taxes for the Standard yearly plan and $229.99/yr. plus applicable taxes for the Premium yearly plan), on a recurring basis, unless you cancel before your next billing period. Offer valid in the U.S. only. To cancel, go to Settings > Subscription in your HBO Max account or contact your provider if you subscribe through a third-party subscription provider (as applicable). Subscription fees are non-refundable. If you switch plans during your discount period, you will lose the benefit of the Offer. No refund or credits for partial years. Offers may be redeemed only once per account, are subject to change without notice and cannot be combined with any other discount or promotional offer.
